g.text: Pi 3.3 V rail also powers PTT1
USB power for SDR1 and SDR2
LNA power carried over RF coax
DCW feeds SP70 over RF coax
Version A / 10 A power stage / rework
Stock OV is about 18 V. Rework before use.
PA protection is a candidate assembly. Stock DC2418A-A settings require SMD rework and bench qualification before operation.
Review OV tolerance, startup behavior, overcurrent settings and enclosure cooling. SEQ1 with R1/R2 provides RF mute and switching.
Unlisted work: 12 V fused loom, 5 V adapter and current limiter, relay harness, R2 NC termination, polarity control and earth bonds.
H1 has a 10 W USB power budget. Two LimeSDRs need up to 9 W combined. ARS1 USB connects directly to PC1. Verify under load.
Custom PA loom: DXE-PW-16 red/black 16 AWG, six feet of two-conductor wire.
Fit the 5 A fuse near J24, before PROT1. The 712A jack is rated 5 A at nominal 24 V.
